blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—La Salle defeated Ateneo, 83-76, in the 100th game of their storied UAAP men’s basketball rivalry at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday night. The Green Archers’ victory evened the rivalry series at 50-50 and pulled them level with the Blue Eagles at 3-2 in the Season 89 standings. “We really discussed how important this is for everyone, so we just toughed it out,” said La Salle coach Topex Robinson. “We did something we committed to and we said whatever happens, we have to stick with what we prepared for.” La […]...
